```plato

    //==
    // Needle — the Conway identity n = kd, equivalently the dual of truncate
    // (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Conway_polyhedron_notation). Each edge
    // becomes two long thin triangles reaching between the apexes of the faces
    // on either side of it, which is what the name describes; the original edge
    // survives only as the diagonal neither triangle uses.
    // V' = V + F, E' = 3E, F' = 2E.

    // The two needles of an edge: each endpoint joined to both neighbouring
    // apexes, wound so the pair share the apex-to-apex edge in opposite senses.
    // Precondition: `corner` is canonical.
    NeedleFacesOfEdge(self: PolygonMesh3D, corner: CornerIndex): Array<Array<VertexIndex>>
    {
        var near = self.ApexVertex(self.CornerFace(corner));
        var far = self.ApexVertex(self.CornerFace(self.TwinCorner(corner)));
        return [[self.CornerVertex(corner), far, near],
                [self.CornerDestination(corner), near, far]];
    }
```
